description.value: AsUsual Cafe is a locally owned Taiwanese restaurant in Victoria's Estevan neighbourhood, founded in 2015 and known for bubble tea, bubble waffles, and mini hot pots. The menu draws broadly from Taiwanese, Japanese, and Hong Kong street-food traditions, with extensive customization options. The cafe operates as a sit-down diner, takeout counter, and online-order hub with pickup and delivery.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 21m; stands (2 spaces) at 27m; rack at 27m; rack at 50m; rack at 83m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms AsUsual Cafe is an active Taiwanese restaurant at 2510 Estevan Avenue, Victoria, corroborating the OSM phone number and address. The menu page explicitly labels numerous items as Vegetarian, Vegan, and Gluten free, and the website states 'Dine In or Take Away' with an online ordering system offering pickup and delivery. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM old_name tag 'King & Thai' indicates this was previously a different restaurant at this location; the current branding as AsUsual Cafe / 老地方 is confirmed by the website.

Online ordering page shows items 'next available for ordering on September 20th at 9:00AM' — this appears to be a scheduling artifact in the ordering system rather than a closure indicator, and the business otherwise appears operational.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a live website, online ordering, and a full menu. Useful to touring cyclists for dine-in meals, takeout, and vegetarian/vegan/GF options.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website also operates a small retail shop (Hakumori boba kits, specialty teas, snacks) under the parent entity TWNO17 Enterprises Ltd.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page labels multiple items with explicit tags: Vegetarian (e.g. A.07 Agedashi Tofu, A.10 Seaweed Salad), Vegan (e.g. A.08 House Fried Tofu), and Gluten free (e.g. A.04 Drunken Chicken, S.03 Fried Potato Tots)
